feature.label: Zacess Themes
feature.description: Accessible colour themes with every text and syntax colour at 7:1 contrast or more, 4.5:1 in the gentler Warm pair: Zacess Light, Zacess Dark, Zacess Yellow on Black, Zacess Cream, Zacess High Contrast Dark, Zacess High Contrast Light, Zacess Deep Contrast Dark, Zacess Deep Contrast Light, Zacess Warm Dark and Zacess Warm Light. Choose one under General, Appearance.
